title: Auto-Install
summary: Administrator authentication is required once to install security packs and apply recommended host hardenings.

privileged.label: Install missing required and recommended packs

body:
Administrator authentication is required once to install security packs and apply recommended host hardenings.

Administrator authentication is required once for:
  • Install missing required and recommended packs

Then continues without further password prompts for:
  • Install daily scheduled scan timer
  • Runtime / maintenance bootstrap

You will not be asked again until this action finishes.
